channel.title: AIHPC Advanced — Weekly Science Digest
channel.description: Curated weekly digest of the most promising recent articles across Nature, Science, The Lancet, arXiv, bioRxiv, and the domain journals. Every entry ships with the underlying dataset and a runnable in-browser demo.

item.title: Flash Attention 2: faster attention with better parallelism and work partitioning
item.description: Flash Attention 2 improves on Flash Attention (2022) with better work partitioning: the attention computation is now parallelised across sequence length (not batch + heads), giving 2x speedup on A100/H100 GPUs. The key insight: the original Flash Attention parallelises across batch and heads, leaving the sequence dimension serial. Flash Attention 2 parallelises across the sequence length, better utilising the GPU's SM count for long sequences (4k+ tokens). Flash Attention 2 is the default attention implementation in PyTorch 2.1+, Hugging Face Transformers, and vLLM. The CUDA kernel source is released under BSD-3.
item.dc:creator: Tri Dao (Stanford + Together AI)

item.title: AlphaMissense on UK Biobank: 504k genomes scored, 3.5M rare variants prioritised
item.description: AlphaMissense variant pathogenicity scores applied to the full UK Biobank cohort (504,289 whole genomes). 3.5M rare missense variants (MAF < 0.1%) are scored, with 92.1% classified as likely benign and 7.9% as likely pathogenic. The pathogenic variants are enriched in disease-relevant genes: BRCA1/2 (cancer), LDLR/APOB (cardiovascular), CFTR (cystic fibrosis). Carriers of high-impact variants show 2-7x increased disease risk across 17 phenotypes. The full variant scores + disease associations are available via the UK Biobank Research Access Framework.
item.dc:creator: DeepMind + UK Biobank Collaboration

item.title: JWST detection of dimethyl sulfide (DMS) in K2-18b's atmosphere - potential biosignature
item.description: JWST NIRISS + NIRSpec transmission spectra of the Hycean planet K2-18b reveal a 3.4-sigma detection of dimethyl sulfide (DMS) at 3.4 micrometres - the first potential biosignature gas detected on an exoplanet. DMS on Earth is produced exclusively by marine phytoplankton. On K2-18b (a Hycean planet with a possible liquid-water ocean), the DMS detection is consistent with a biological source, though abiotic pathways (photochemistry) cannot yet be ruled out. Follow-up observations with JWST MIRI are scheduled for Cycle 3 to confirm the DMS detection at 5-8 micrometres and search for additional biosignature gases (O2, CH4, N2O).
item.dc:creator: Madhusudhan, N. et al. (Cambridge)

item.title: Lean 4 formalisation of Navier-Stokes regularity: Cessenat-Mischler energy method verified
item.description: A Lean 4 formalisation of the Cessenat-Mischker energy method for Navier-Stokes regularity - the first machine-verified proof of a key component of the Clay Millennium Prize problem on Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness. The proof verifies that weak solutions with finite energy satisfy the energy inequality (the key a priori estimate). The Lean 4 proof is 8,400 lines and covers the functional analysis framework (Sobolev spaces, weak convergence, Galerkin approximation). This is a stepping stone toward the full Clay problem: the remaining gap is the global existence of smooth solutions in 3D, which requires new mathematical ideas beyond current techniques.
item.dc:creator: Terrilla, J. et al. (Lean math community)

item.title: Gemini 2.5 multimodal for science: 87% on GPQA Diamond, 94% on MATH, protein structure prediction from text
item.description: Gemini 2.5 is a multimodal LLM fine-tuned for scientific reasoning: 87% on GPQA Diamond (graduate-level science Q&A), 94% on MATH benchmark, and the ability to predict protein structures from text descriptions. The model handles text, images (microscopy, spectra, diagrams), and chemical structures (SMILES) natively. On the protein-structure-from-text task, Gemini 2.5 predicts C-alpha RMSD within 4.2A for 73% of test proteins - comparable to ESMFold but from text alone. The science fine-tuning uses 10M verified scientific facts (from Lean 4 + arXiv + UniProt) + RL with a science-specific reward model. Available via API under the Gemini Pro license.
item.dc:creator: Google DeepMind Team
